newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares close firmer on interest in Telecom, BIL.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares close firmer on interest in Telecom, BIL.

text.p: * NZ shares firmer, leaders up in light trade
* Prices continue to firm after Wall St close
* Brierley strengthens on better Thistle price
Price movements at close
LAST CHG
321 nil * NZSC cap index +6.38 at 5,084.70
291 nil * NZSE-10 cap index +6.66 at 1,176.65
341 +2 * Volume NZ$41.5 million Futures untraded
727 +5 * Other movers - FER +10 -9
New Zealand shares were firmer at Friday's close, buoyed by interest in Telecom and Brierley Investments.
The NZSE-40 capital index closed 9.57 points stronger at 2,369.21, having closed last Friday at 2,350.42.
The market opened weaker on Friday in response to falls on Wall Street, but recovered as the Dow Jones rebounded and by late morning was in positive territory.
"The bulk of the rise was in Telecom and there was good volume in Carter Holt Harvey, equally bid and offered," Ord Minnett broker Geoff Brown said.
Carter Holt Harvey closed level at NZ$3.21.
Brown said there was renewed interest in investment company Brierley Investments on the back of an improving share price for its Thistle hotel group holding in the U.K.

"We have seen in the past at the beginning of a quarter and particularly at the beginning of a year a bit of international money destined for New Zealand," Brown said. But he said he would not read too much into these short-term variations on thin volume.

"All things being equal, the market will concentrate a little more on what is happening internationally and I would have thought the concerns about the overvalued Dow plus where interest rates might go to, short term, will probably see the market ease back a bit," he said.
